_comment: Site config for the 4-node DISAGGREGATED Kimi-K3 MI300X tag: pyt_vllm_disagg_mori_kimi-k3 (2 prefill + 2 decode)
_note_results_dir: Differs from the colocated config: this launcher lives in scripts/vllm_dissag/ and copies its CSV to <script dir>/perf_Kimi-K3.csv.
_note_env_vars: MODEL_DIR defaults to /shared_inference/models_blog/ and weights are read from $MODEL_DIR/Kimi-K3. LOG_PATH defaults to /shared_inference/$USER/model_blog_logs. Override both unless your cluster has /shared_inference. Every key under env_vars becomes an `export` in the generated SBATCH wrapper, so keep it to real variables.
